messages:
maya: Heads-up: SDK v4.2 will change telemetry default to opt-out. By default the SDK will NOT send usage telemetry; customers must explicitly set `telemetry.enabled = true` to opt in. Migration notes and docs live now.

oliver: Quick Q — what drove this? legal push or customer privacy requests?

maya: Both. Legal requested default opt-out for Dedicated/Private customers and several enterprise accounts asked for it. Also reduces compliance burden. We include a local debug shim for engineers who need telemetry during testing.

sam: How will this affect feature flags and experiments that rely on client metrics?

maya: Short-term: we’ll add a server-side fallback for experiments and a grace opt-in period for orgs that have active experiments. Ops will run a list & contact owners.

docs-bot: Docs published: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/sdk/telemetry/opt-out-change. Changelog entry added to /sdk/v4.2. Migration snippet and sample tests included.

oliver: Can we get a config snippet to drop into infra templates?

maya: Example: `sdk.init({ telemetry: { enabled: true, sample_rate: 0.1 } })` or env `REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=true`. Full examples in the doc.

sam: Ops will emit a report of orgs with telemetry usage and start outreach. Also adding an internal alert if many orgs opt-out suddenly.

maya: Thanks — please file any customer blockers in #docs-feedback and tag me. Closing once customer emails go out.
